questions.question: Which of the following articles of the Constitution of India states that there shall be a special officer for linguistic minorities to be appointed by the President?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 350B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Originally, the Constitution of India** did not make any provision** with respect to the Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities.
 
• Later, the States Reorganization Commission (1953-55) made a recommendation in this regard.
 
• Accordingly, the** Seventh Constitutional Amendment Act of 1956** inserted a new Article 350-B in **Part XVII** of the Constitution.
 
• **This article contains the following provisions:**
 
 
• There should be a Special Officer for **Linguistic Minorities**.
 
• He is to be appointed by the **President** of India.
 
• It would be the duty of the Special Officer to investigate all matters relating to the safeguards provided for linguistic minorities under the Constitution.
 
• He would report to the President upon those matters at such intervals as the** President may direct**.
 
• The President should place all such reports before each **House of Parliament** and send them to the governments of the states concerned.
 
• It must be noted here that the** Constitution **does not specify the qualifications, tenure, salaries and allowances, service conditions, and procedure for removal of the **Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities**.

questions.question: UPI is a system that powers multiple bank accounts into a single mobile application. What is the full form of UPI?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Unified Payments Interface**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unified Payments Interface**

 
 
• Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is a system that powers multiple bank accounts into a single mobile application (of any participating bank), merging several banking features, seamless fund routing & merchant payments into one hood.
 
• It also caters to the “Peer to Peer” collect request which can be scheduled and paid as per requirement and convenience.
 
• NPCI conducted a pilot launch on 11th April 2016 by Dr Raghuram G Rajan, Governor, RBI at Mumbai.
 
• Banks have started to upload their UPI-enabled Apps on the Google Play store from 25th August 2016 onwards.
 
 
 
• **Participants in UPI**
 
 
• Payer PSP (Payment service Provider)
 
• Payee PSP
 
• Remitter Bank
 
• Beneficiary Bank
 
• NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India)
 
• Bank Account holders
 
• Merchant
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mobile Banking**

 
 
• It refers to the use of a mobile device to carry out financial transactions anywhere.
 
• ​This service is provided by majorly all financial institutions, especially banks.
 
• Mobile banking enables customers to carry out various transactions, which may vary depending on the institutions.
 
• Mobile banking services can be categorized into, account information, transaction, investment, support service, content, and news.
 
• It can be done either through the internet or by SMS.
 
• In 2002 mobile banking was started in India by a way through SMS

questions.question:
Which of the following is/are NOT true about revenue receipts?

I. They are receipts of the government which are non-redeemable.

II. They can be claimed from the government under special circumstances.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• There is a constitutional requirement in India **(Article 112) **to present before the Parliament a statement of estimated receipts and expenditures of the government in respect of every financial year which runs from 1 April to 31 March.
 
• This ‘Annual Financial Statement’ constitutes the main budget document.
 
• Therefore, the budget comprises of the-Revenue Budget and the Capital Budget.
 
• The Revenue Budget shows the current receipts of the government and the expenditure that can be met from these receipts.
 
• Revenue receipts are receipts of the government which are non-redeemable, that is, they cannot be reclaimed from the government. They are divided into tax and non-tax revenues. Hence, statement 1 is correct.
 
• They **can not be** claimed by the government under special circumstances. Hence, 2 statement is **incorrect**.

questions.question: How many hydrogen atoms does a molecule of calcium hydroxide contain?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Two**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂)** contain** two hydrogen atoms molecule.**
 
• **Calcium hydroxide**, also **called slaked lime, Ca(OH)2, **is **obtained **by the action of **water **on **calcium oxide.**
 
• When **mixed **with **water**, a small proportion of it dissolves, forming a solution known as **limewater**, the rest remaining as a **suspension **called **milk of lime**.
 
• **Calcium hydroxide** is **used **as an** industrial alkali** and as a constituent of mortars, **plasters**, and **cement**.
 
• It is used in the** kraft pape**r process and as a flocculant in **sewage treatment.**

questions.question: When is the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer observed globally every year?

• In **1985**, the world’s governments adopted the** Vienna Convention **for the Protection of the **Ozone Layer**.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about redworms ?

options.text: A redworm can eat food equal to its own weight, in a day.
Redworms need dry surroundings for their survival.
They have a structure called ‘gizzard’, which helps them in grinding their food.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Redworms need dry surroundings for their survival**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Redworms do not have teeth. They have a structure called ‘gizzard’, which helps them in grinding their food. 
 
• A redworm can eat food equal to its own weight, in a day.
 
• Redworms do not survive in very hot or very cold surroundings. They also need moisture around them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Red worms are more commonly known as **red wigglers**.
 
• These are the earthworms employed in** vermicomposting**.
 
• **Eisenia fetida **is the scientific name for Redworms.
 
• The species is** hermaphroditic** (can produce gametes related to both males and females).
 
• The **Cerebral Ganglion** helps them sense moisture, Heat, Light, and Vibrations.
 
• These creatures have** 5 hearts **that regulate the flow of nutrients and oxygen.
 
• Their **Pharynx sucks** in the food that travels down to the oesophagus, crop.
 
• And then to **gizzard** where even the hard soil particles are crushed.
 
• Thereafter** intestines** digest the food. Nutrients are absorbed and waste is excreted.
 
• Their** excreta** is used as fertilizer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vermicomposting **is a process in which earthworms are used to convert** organic** materials into humus-like material known as **vermicompost**.

questions.question: In the context of Bhakti-Sufi traditions of India, Manikkavachakar, a devotee of ______, composed beautiful devotional songs in Tamil.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shiva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manikkavachakar **or **Maanikka Vaasagar **was a** 9th-century Tamil poet **who wrote **Tiruvasakam**, a book of **Shiva’s hymns.**
 
• He was one of the major writers of Saivite Thirumurai.
 
• He was the principal adherent of the Nayanars traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Nayanars**
 **Alvars**
 
 

 Nayanars were devoted to Lord Shiva and his Avatars
 Alvars were devoted to Lord Vishnu and his Avatars
 
 

 Nayanars were active around the 6th-8th Century AD
 Although modern scholars consider the Alvars to be active between the 5th and 10th century AD, they are believed to have lived between 4200 BCE - 2700 BCE.
 
 

 The high priest of Raja Raja Chola I, Nambiyandar Nambi, compiled the hymn into a series of volumes called the thirumurai.
 The hymns of Alvars were made into a consolidated volume known as Divya Prabandha
 
 

 There were 63 Nayanars, who belonged to different caste backgrounds such as potters, “untouchable” workers, peasants, hunters, soldiers, Brahmanas, and chiefs.
 There were 12 Alvars, who came from equally divergent backgrounds, the best known being Periyalvar, his daughter Andal, Tondaradippodi Alvar and Nammalvar.

questions.question: The division of powers between the Union and the States is in the ______ Schedule.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The division of powers between the Union and the States is in the Seventh Schedule.**
 
• Seventh Schedule
 
• It contains three lists:
 
 
• Union List,
 
• State List and
 
• Concurrent List
 
 
 
• 7th Schedule of Indian Constitution – Union List had 97 subjects. Now, it has 100 subjects.
 
 
• 88th Amendment added a new subject in the Union List called ‘taxes on services.’
 
 
 
• The state list has 61 subjects. Earlier, it had 66 items.
 
 
• The 69th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1991 made special provisions in relation to National Capital. Laws cannot be made by the Delhi government on three subjects under State List named as – Public Order, Police & Land.
 
 
 
• The concurrent list has 52 subjects enumerated under it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Third Schedule
 Forms of oath and affirmations of members of legislatures, ministers, and judges.
 
 

 Fourth Schedule.
 Allocation of seats to states and union territories in the Rajya Sabha.
 
 

 Fifth Schedule.
 Administration and control of Scheduled Areas and STs.
